_doc: Format of a task's scorecard (scorecard.py). Made-up values. Every number cites where it came from in REPORT.md. A field left out counts as not measured, never as a pass.

upstream.scaling: upstream 8 GPUs x 4 micro-batches -> 2 GPUs, same per-GPU load, global batch / 4

A._doc: Desk review, no GPU. realism = the realism card; ambiguities_open = rules with two readings not yet settled.

realism.expert_anchor: upstream performance PR #123 (measured on the same GPUs in B)
published_fast_versions: <fork or PR that is off limits; also the log search that audits it>

ambiguities.rule: may the agent change ZeRO stage?
ambiguities.settled: no: ZeRO-1 as upstream, checked by gate 0

B._doc: Bounds and baseline strength, about one GPU-day per GPU. t_* in the unit above; aa_spread = |a-b|/mean of two reference timings; ladder = best combination of existing switches within the rules; scale_shift = largest change of the GEMM / memory / comm / host time shares at full scale (0.04 = 4 points).

C._doc: Judge and mutation testing. got = the verdict the startup preparation or a check gave the mutant; must_accept rejected = runs rejected; frr_predicted from frr.py --measured.

red_team.notes: read the frozen timing file to detect timing

D._doc: Pilot: the model(s) the owner names, at least one full-budget cell; label = the model, a replicate is <label>-rep, rank = leaderboard rank (optional). speedup = the final check's; cause for every non-PASS: model | judge | infra.

failures.notes: changed the loss reduction order across ranks; real error
